content: Zombie Trader STAND ALONE In the early part of 2020 – a College Graduate for his thesis project takes a prion disease and manipulates it to create his final thesis project, a zombie like mutagen that he perfects on rats. With the assured knowledge that because of cross species transmission of diseases that humans were safe. After being bitten by the rat he learns quickly that his manipulation has created a disease with the ability to jump species. He becomes patient zero. With  a  24  hours incubation time and the ability for airborne transmission the disease spreads turning 98% of the populace in to something resembling the walking dead. With heightened hearing but slow moving the other 2 % of the populace is forced to survive in a new world of the walking death. This story follows a small group of survivors from different backgrounds and geographic locations who try to survive in this new world by becoming scavengers and traders across the south east of the united states and the trials and tribulations they run into , including the wraiths (walking dead like people and animals (rodents). And other people who both the best and the worst have come out in, in this new world where survival depends on the speed of your reflexes and the ability to outthink those who would do you hard. NOTES: These are notes on the book that I can add later as I think of things  Benson – Graduate student with social issues, huge movie buff, very book smart but not much common sense.  Studying at Johns Hopkins Richard – A volunteer fireman in South Carolina who watched his wife and kids burn to  death , Ex  military  and very smart.  Thomas – A mechanical engineer from  Philidelphia  forced to kill his wife and young son Pip – A cop from New York who barely escaped with her life also  ex marine , family is  missing  and she is determined to find them Alice – A reporter from Wisconsin who grew up in Chicago and learned early how to take care of herself  Muzzy – A aging hippy who spent too much time with drugs and not enough with people  Sky –  Muzzy’s  wife who aside from being a hippy believes that the  zombie’s  are mother  natures  retribution for destroying our planet. But that doesn’t stop her from killing them when in danger.  Roger – A Vietnam veteran and a survival nut who spent a little too much time planning for the end of the world instead of enjoying  it .   This is a second sub note  This is yet another note.
